query: 'SELECT a.admission_id                                      AS admission_id_bk,
       p.paciente_key,
       d.departamento_key,
       dg.diagnostico_key,
       CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
       CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_alta_key,
       a.attending_doctor_id                               AS medico_id,
       DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date)   AS dias_estancia,
       1                                                   AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions a
JOIN gold.dim_paciente     p ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
JOIN gold.dim_departamento d ON d.nombre_departamento = a.department
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 x.icd_code, ISNULL(x.severity, 'Unknown') AS sev
    FROM silver.diagnoses x
    WHERE x.admission_id = a.admission_id
    ORDER BY x.diagnosis_id
) fd
JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dg
  ON dg.codigo_icd = ISNULL(fd.icd_code, 'N/A')
 AND dg.nivel_severidad = ISNULL(fd.sev, 'Unknown')',
